questions: Have you noticed repetitive clicking or fluttering in either ear?
Has anyone observed rhythmic involuntary movements of your eyes?
Does the palatal movement continue while you are asleep?
Do you have double vision, blurred vision, or difficulty keeping your eyes still?
Do you have difficulty walking, loss of balance, or clumsiness?
Do you have slurred speech or difficulty swallowing?
Do you have weakness, numbness, or altered sensation in your face or limbs?
Did it begin after a stroke, head injury, brain infection, or neurosurgical procedure?
Have you ever been diagnosed with a lesion, tumor, demyelinating disease, or vascular abnormality in your brainstem or cerebellum?
Have you had brain MRI or CT imaging for this problem?
Do you have involuntary movements elsewhere in your face, tongue, throat, or body?
Does the movement lessen or stop when you voluntarily hold your breath or tense your throat?
Did the movement begin after starting or increasing a medication?
Do you take antipsychotic, antiemetic, antidepressant, anticonvulsant, or stimulant medication?
Have you previously had similar episodes that resolved?
Do you have hearing loss, ear fullness, or a sensation of movement in either ear?
